canonicalName: Tarski truth definition and model theory

milestones.label: Tarski's truth definition for formalized languages
milestones.work: A. Tarski, Pojecie prawdy w jezykach nauk dedukcyjnych (1933); German: Der Wahrheitsbegriff in den formalisierten Sprachen
milestones.description: Tarski gives a formally correct definition of truth for formalized languages.

evidence.claim: SEP confirms the 1933 Polish publication of the truth-definition paper

milestones.note: The German version's year (1935 in catalogue) was not confirmed; Crossref only lists later reprints (1971, 1986).

notes: Searched SEP, Crossref. SEP dates the modern model-theoretic truth definition to Tarski-Vaught 1956 (not opened as primary). Naming/institution of model theory not verified. Catalogue 1935 and 1954 dates unverified.
